topic: The wedding dinner: Chacha Jee's master plan to be first in the biryani line.

episode.title: Biryani Ki Line Mein Chacha Number One!

shots.narration: آج بریانی کی پہلی پلیٹ میری، منصوبہ بالکل پکا ہے!
shots.scene: Bright Pakistani wedding courtyard, floral garlands, covered biryani pot on a buffet table, no writing anywhere, warm 3D animated comedy look, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chacha holds an enormous empty plate proudly against his belly.
shots.mood: Raised eyebrows, broad confident grin, sunny gold lighting.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، چچا، ابھی تو دیگ بھی بند ہے!
shots.scene: Beside the wedding buffet, a large metal biryani pot with its lid firmly closed, floral courtyard background, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Pappu points at the closed biryani pot while Chacha clutches his plate.
shots.mood: Pappu wears a patient half-smile; Chacha looks completely untroubled.

shots.narration: جہاں دیگ، وہیں میری کرسی؛ پہلا نمبر پکا!
shots.scene: Wedding buffet with an empty space directly behind the biryani pot, warm festive courtyard, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chacha places a chair directly behind the serving pot.
shots.mood: Chacha beams triumphantly; Pappu studies the chair with a doubtful expression.

shots.narration: چچا اپنی جگہ ایسے جمے، جیسے کرسی کے مالک!
shots.scene: Behind the wedding buffet, chair facing outward over the covered biryani pot, oversized plate resting on the table, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chacha settles into the chair with his arms folded.
shots.mood: Regal posture, lifted chin, exaggerated self-satisfaction.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، یہاں تو کھانا بانٹنے والا بیٹھتا ہے!
shots.scene: Serving side of the wedding buffet, long serving ladle beside the covered biryani pot, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Pappu holds the long serving ladle out toward Chacha.
shots.mood: Pappu looks gently amused; Chacha keeps a stubborn smile.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، بس دیکھتے جاؤ، بریانی پہلے میں کھاؤں گا!
shots.scene: Behind the wedding buffet, Chacha seated beside the covered pot and his oversized empty plate, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chacha taps his empty plate with one confident finger.
shots.mood: Unshakable confidence on Chacha's face, knowing smile on Pappu's face.

shots.narration: چچی آئیں، تو چچا کا منصوبہ انہیں بھی پسند آیا!
shots.scene: Wedding buffet beneath flower garlands, Chacha seated behind the biryani pot, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chachi ties a plain serving apron around Chacha's waist.
shots.mood: Chachi smiles sweetly; Chacha looks proudly important; Pappu suppresses a grin.

shots.narration: دیگ کھلی، مگر چچا کے ہاتھ میں چمچ آگیا!
shots.scene: Open pot of steaming biryani on the wedding buffet, lid resting beside it, Chachi holding an empty dinner plate on the guest side, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chachi places the long serving ladle into Chacha's hand.
shots.mood: Chacha's smile freezes; Chachi looks delighted; Pappu grins.

shots.narration: پہلے نمبر پر چچا کھلائیں گے؛ اگلا امتحان شادی کا تحفہ!
shots.scene: Wedding buffet with steaming biryani, Chachi waiting opposite apron-wearing Chacha, Pappu beside a small gift table with an empty decorative tray, no writing, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: Chacha ladles the first serving of biryani onto Chachi's plate.
shots.mood: Chachi wears a victorious smile; Chacha has a sheepish grin; Pappu looks curious

episode.endHook: Agli baar: Chacha Jee shaadi ka tohfa kahan bhool aaye?
episode.description: شادی کی بریانی سب سے پہلے کھانے کے لیے چچا جی نے زبردست منصوبہ بنایا۔ مگر چچی جان نے پہلے نمبر کا مطلب ہی بدل دیا!
